en: Composite black‑and‑white postcard showing seven separate photographs mounted on a white background. The images depict: an industrial complex or factory by a road with a tall chimney and forested hills behind; a large country house or manor on elevated ground; a small church with a tall, onion‑shaped spire and walled churchyard; several substantial two‑story civic or residential buildings that resemble schools, municipal offices, or villas; and a street scene with a horse‑drawn wagon in front of a long multi‑story building. The architecture is Central European, with simple plastered facades, hipped or gabled roofs, and rural surroundings. No visible captioning or printed text appears on the front.
